personas.title: Machine-learning researcher

personas.title: Compiler researcher

personas.title: Noise and estimation researcher

personas.title: Device experimenter

personas.title: Error-correction and fault-tolerance researcher

personas.title: Control and calibration researcher

personas.title: Analog-computing researcher

personas.title: Application and integration engineer

sources.title: OpenQASM language specification
sources.role: Program semantics, classical control, timing and calibration boundaries; a language standard is not a mandate that every target support every feature.

sources.title: QIR specification and execution profiles
sources.role: Interchange and explicit execution-profile boundaries; no universal target gate set is assumed.

sources.title: MolSSI QCSchema components
sources.role: Scientific input/output metadata, model and basis conventions needed for reproducible chemistry tasks.

sources.title: Analog Hamiltonian simulation terminology
sources.role: Evidence that native analog users specify time-dependent Hamiltonians; vendor-specific limits are not universal requirements.

sources.title: Strawberry Fields research paper
sources.role: Primary research describing photonic/CV workflows; motivates mode, Gaussian/Fock and measurement requirements without prescribing an implementation.

sources.title: Formulation and sampling workflow
sources.role: Evidence of optimization-model, sampler and hybrid-solver user journeys; particular APIs are not required.

sources.title: Stabilizer and QEC circuit workflows
sources.role: Concrete QEC workload context for detector events and logical observables; no preferred simulator or decoder is designated.

sources.title: Differentiable hybrid interfaces
sources.role: Evidence of quantum/classical derivative boundaries; no classical framework or derivative method is privileged.

sources.title: Open-system dynamics workflow
sources.role: Hamiltonian, dissipator and solver conventions for dynamics studies; no solver implementation is prescribed.

sources.title: MPI Forum standards
sources.role: Communication semantics and explicit runtime versions; this source does not establish that any SDK recovers from failures.

sources.title: Sampler execution and result interface
sources.role: Concrete hardware job/result workflow context; neither this provider nor its API is a universal interface requirement.

sources.title: Measurement-based computation patterns
sources.role: Primary project documentation for graph-state patterns, dependent measurements and corrections; motivates a distinct user task, not a required implementation or frontend.

functions.title: Install a reproducible environment
functions.contract: Resolve documented dependencies and verify executable imports in a clean supported environment.

functions.title: Discover capabilities and limits
functions.contract: Query supported models, devices, operations, precision and explicit rejection conditions.

functions.title: Learn and diagnose a workflow
functions.contract: Execute documented examples and surface actionable input, installation and runtime errors.

functions.title: Configure execution without exposing secrets
functions.contract: Select accounts and execution settings while keeping credentials out of artifacts and diagnostics.

functions.title: Extend an execution path
functions.contract: Register a provider or computation component through a documented boundary with validated errors.

functions.title: Construct and inspect programs
functions.contract: Represent ordered operations or structured graphs, wires/modes, registers, parameters and declared semantics.

functions.title: Compose, invert and control subprograms
functions.contract: Preserve operation order, global-phase conventions and workspace contracts during program construction.

functions.title: Bind and reuse parameters
functions.contract: Support symbolic or deferred parameters, shared occurrences, binding and repeated execution.

functions.title: Prepare states and encode inputs
functions.contract: Represent input states, isometries, encodings and associated normalization or approximation contracts.

functions.title: Represent mixed-dimensional systems
functions.contract: Declare wire dimensions and reject invalid operations rather than silently treating every subsystem as a qubit.

functions.title: Measure and reset during execution
functions.contract: Represent destructive or nondestructive measurement and reset with explicit state semantics.

functions.title: Condition on recorded outcomes
functions.contract: Preserve classical registers, predicates, branches and output mappings.

functions.title: Execute bounded loops and adaptive routines
functions.contract: Apply declared iteration, termination and feed-forward semantics.

functions.title: Track workspace and classical state
functions.contract: Allocate, reuse and release resources without leaking quantum or classical state.

functions.title: Assess execution-profile compatibility
functions.contract: Reject unsupported dynamic features before execution and identify any transformation or emulation.

functions.title: Represent states and linear operators
functions.contract: Specify basis, dimensions, units, Hermiticity and dense or sparse data without implicit changes.

functions.title: Manipulate structured observables
functions.contract: Compose, simplify and act with Pauli sums, sparse operators and symmetry sectors.

functions.title: Map fermionic and bosonic models
functions.contract: Preserve algebra, particle or mode ordering, encoding and truncation metadata.

functions.title: Specify scientific problem inputs
functions.contract: Record geometry, basis, charge, spin, boundary conditions and constants needed to reproduce a model.

functions.title: Formulate objectives and constraints
functions.contract: Translate application variables, constraints and objectives with reversible interpretation of outputs.

functions.title: Evolve a state from an explicit input
functions.contract: Compute ideal evolution without changing initial-state, wire-order or precision semantics.

functions.title: Sample declared measurements
functions.contract: Return shots, outcomes and register mappings from the declared measurement process.

functions.title: Compute exact observables and reduced states
functions.contract: Return specified amplitudes, probabilities, expectations, correlations or partial traces.

functions.title: Execute adaptive and nonunitary semantics
functions.contract: Handle permitted measurements, reset and branches consistently with the execution profile.

functions.title: Select and disclose execution implementation
functions.contract: Expose actual method, device, numeric precision, batching, synchronization and fallback provenance.

functions.title: Describe an executable target
functions.contract: Represent supported operations, connectivity, timing, calibration snapshot and target limits.

functions.title: Synthesize and decompose operations
functions.contract: Lower unitary, state-preparation and structured operations within declared error and workspace bounds.

functions.title: Optimize while preserving semantics
functions.contract: Rewrite a program with verified ordering, phase, parameters and classical behavior.

functions.title: Place, route and recover logical outputs
functions.contract: Respect connectivity and track initial/final logical-to-physical permutations.

functions.title: Schedule and account for resources
functions.contract: Respect declared durations, alignments, dependencies and resource conflicts.

functions.title: Expose compile tradeoffs and diagnostics
functions.contract: Record budgets, seeds, failed constraints and quality/time tradeoffs without substituting an unrelated task.

functions.title: Control representation and truncation
functions.contract: Select MPS, tensor networks or other structured methods with explicit approximation settings.

functions.title: Plan contractions and memory use
functions.contract: Search, cache and execute contraction or slicing plans under a declared resource budget.

functions.title: Track numerical and approximation error
functions.contract: Preserve normalization, discarded weights, truncation and observable-error evidence.

functions.title: Simulate structured evolution
functions.contract: Evolve low-entanglement, symmetry-restricted or time-dependent systems with declared discretization.

functions.title: Return outputs without accidental densification
functions.contract: Compute specified local or sampled outputs without materializing an unnecessary exponential state.

functions.title: Compute first derivatives
functions.contract: Differentiate declared outputs with respect to real parameters with explicit complex-value conventions.

functions.title: Compute Jacobians and derivative products
functions.contract: Support vector outputs, JVPs or VJPs with documented shapes and parameter sharing.

functions.title: Compute higher-order derivatives
functions.contract: Expose supported Hessians or Hessian-vector products and reject unsupported paths.

functions.title: Estimate derivatives with finite shots
functions.contract: Account for sampling variance, bias, shifted evaluations and shot allocation.

functions.title: Disclose derivative method and cost
functions.contract: Record analytic, automatic, adjoint, shift or finite-difference method, calls, memory and fallback.

functions.title: Integrate quantum and classical models
functions.contract: Preserve gradients, dtype, device and parameter ownership through a hybrid computation.

functions.title: Batch independent data and parameters
functions.contract: Define broadcasting, minibatches, multiple observables and distinct parameter sets.

functions.title: Optimize and evaluate reproducibly
functions.contract: Track objectives, constraints, seeds, datasets, convergence and held-out evaluation.

functions.title: Checkpoint and resume training
functions.contract: Save model, optimizer, random state and relevant execution state for a controlled continuation.

functions.title: Budget training and adaptive search
functions.contract: Account for all objective/gradient calls, shots, preprocessing and parameter-search cost.

functions.title: Specify channels and readout models
functions.contract: Represent noise ordering, locality, units, physical constraints and classical confusion.

functions.title: Execute noisy density or trajectory evolution
functions.contract: Compute mixed-state evolution with explicit integration or trajectory settings.

functions.title: Model time-dependent open systems
functions.contract: Represent Hamiltonians, dissipators, frames, units and solver tolerances.

functions.title: Apply and assess error mitigation
functions.contract: Track calibration, assumptions, raw/mitigated outputs, variance and extra executions.

functions.title: Validate noise predictions out of sample
functions.contract: Evaluate a frozen noise or device model against held-out measurements with drift and validity limits.

functions.title: Discover and select execution targets
functions.contract: Inspect availability and supported execution profiles without claiming device access from an adapter alone.

functions.title: Prepare a budgeted experiment
functions.contract: Construct circuit or program batches with shot, cost, time and resource estimates or explicit unknowns.

functions.title: Submit and manage asynchronous jobs
functions.contract: Submit only with explicit authorization and retain identities, status, cancellation and provider errors.

functions.title: Recover and reconcile partial work
functions.contract: Retrieve prior jobs and handle retries, partial failures and duplicate-submission hazards.

functions.title: Preserve acquisition and result provenance
functions.contract: Bind results to programs, parameter bindings, mappings, shots, acquisition times and target metadata.

functions.title: Validate and normalize result records
functions.contract: Distinguish counts, samples, probabilities, quasi-probabilities and missing outcomes with explicit bit/mode mappings.

functions.title: Estimate quantities with uncertainty
functions.contract: Use declared estimators, confidence or credible intervals and finite-sample assumptions.

functions.title: Plan and combine measurements
functions.contract: Group compatible observables and allocate shots while preserving correlations and total cost.

functions.title: Reconstruct and diagnose states or processes
functions.contract: Evaluate tomography, shadows or fitted models under declared identifiability and validation assumptions.

functions.title: Export interpretable analysis
functions.contract: Preserve units, uncertainty, failed fits, raw data, transformations and machine-readable diagnostics.

functions.title: Solve energy or spectral problems
functions.contract: Compute a declared ground/excited-state or spectral target with a specified reference and total energy convention.

functions.title: Study dynamics and correlations
functions.contract: Compute time-dependent observables of a fixed physical model with controlled errors.

functions.title: Solve optimization instances
functions.contract: Return feasible decoded solutions, objective values and a declared optimality or quality reference.

functions.title: Estimate algorithmic quantities
functions.contract: Implement phase, amplitude or linear-algebra workflows with complete oracle and state-preparation costs.

functions.title: Evaluate predictive or kernel methods
functions.contract: Use fixed datasets, splits, preprocessing, regularization and classical comparison protocols.

functions.title: Specify codes and logical observables
functions.contract: Record checks, logical operators, geometry, boundary and commutation conventions.

functions.title: Build repeated error-correction experiments
functions.contract: Preserve syndrome rounds, reset, noise locations, detector events and observable labels.

functions.title: Construct and sample detector error models
functions.contract: Declare approximation, correlation handling and event-to-observable relationships.

functions.title: Decode and estimate logical outcomes
functions.contract: Track decoder assumptions, latency, failure probabilities, confidence and unmatched syndromes.

functions.title: Compile logical operations and estimate resources
functions.contract: State logical protocol, error budget, code assumptions, physical resources and extrapolation boundaries.

functions.title: Represent waveforms and channels
functions.contract: Define samples, units, frames, ports, amplitude limits and device calibration associations.

functions.title: Schedule physical controls
functions.contract: Respect clock, alignment, channel conflicts and simultaneous-control constraints.

functions.title: Simulate driven dynamics
functions.contract: Represent rotating frames, Hamiltonians and dissipators with controlled time integration.

functions.title: Calibrate or optimize controls
functions.contract: Use a fixed objective, evaluation budget, held-out validation and explicit model/device execution provenance.

functions.title: Preserve gate-to-control correspondence
functions.contract: Track calibrated gate realizations and reject stale or incompatible pulse definitions.

functions.title: Describe geometry and interactions
functions.contract: Define sites, species, boundaries, interactions, units and initialization.

functions.title: Define time-dependent controls
functions.contract: Represent schedules, fields, interpolation, local/global control and hardware limits.

functions.title: Simulate and measure analog evolution
functions.contract: Return specified observables or samples with disclosed approximation and solver settings.

functions.title: Translate to a compatible analog device
functions.contract: Validate geometry and control constraints and report rounding or unsupported features.

functions.title: Track losses and analog experiment context
functions.contract: Retain loading, atom loss, postselection, denominators and acquisition provenance.

functions.title: Represent modes and conventions
functions.contract: Declare mode order, commutation and quadrature conventions, units and input states.

functions.title: Evolve Gaussian and non-Gaussian processes
functions.contract: Represent Gaussian transformations and required non-Gaussian operations without silent substitution.

functions.title: Control Fock-space approximation
functions.contract: Declare cutoff, discarded probability, normalization and convergence evidence.

functions.title: Sample photonic measurements
functions.contract: Define homodyne, heterodyne or photon-counting outcomes, losses and postselection.

functions.title: Compile or adapt mode programs
functions.contract: Preserve interferometer, feed-forward, target constraints and observable semantics.

functions.title: Represent quadratic and constrained models
functions.contract: Declare binary/spin domains, coefficients, offsets, constraints and penalty construction.

functions.title: Embed and scale for a target
functions.contract: Track chains, coefficient scaling, topology and decoding back to logical variables.

functions.title: Execute declared sampling schedules
functions.contract: Record anneal schedules, gauges, reads, initialization and solver type.

functions.title: Decode and validate candidate solutions
functions.contract: Report feasibility, chain breaks, objective reconstruction and any repair or postprocessing.

functions.title: Account for hybrid optimization cost
functions.contract: Distinguish classical, quantum and hybrid work and state access to reference optima.

functions.title: Select and measure compute resources
functions.contract: Record CPU/GPU/accelerator allocation, threads, precision, memory and device synchronization.

functions.title: Partition states or tensor computations
functions.contract: Specify sharding, replication, contraction slicing, communication and output gathering.

functions.title: Parallelize independent work
functions.contract: Batch data, shots, observables or parameter points without confusing throughput with state capacity.

functions.title: Measure and enforce execution budgets
functions.contract: Track wall time, memory, device time, communication and censored resource-limit outcomes.

functions.title: Recover long-running execution
functions.contract: Record checkpoints, failure injection, recovery state and correctness after restart.

functions.title: Import and export declared formats
functions.contract: Declare format versions and preserve or explicitly reject program features and metadata.

functions.title: Normalize conventions across boundaries
functions.contract: Convert wire order, dimensions, measurement mapping, units and phase/parameter conventions explicitly.

functions.title: Round-trip artifacts without hidden loss
functions.contract: Compare semantics, retain conversion diagnostics and identify irrecoverable information loss.

functions.title: Package reproducible evidence
functions.contract: Hash inputs and retain environment, versions, seeds, raw results, settings and execution dependency chains.

functions.title: Expose inspectable errors and traces
functions.contract: Retain stage-specific diagnostics and prevent silent fallback, hidden postselection or successful-looking partial results.

journeys.title: Start and maintain a usable project
Make a program executable on a target
Compute the quantities a study needs
Train and differentiate a hybrid model
Answer a scientific or application question
Run a photonic or continuous-variable study
Solve through annealing or hybrid optimization
Scale and operate a computational study

tasks.title: Start a working project in a clean environment
tasks.user_need: A new user must reach a first valid result without undocumented setup.
tasks.inputs: A frozen supported OS, interpreter, package source and documented installation procedure.
tasks.required_output: An environment manifest, complete install log and a checked example result.
tasks.acceptance: Installation and the example complete without undeclared manual steps; resolved versions match the manifest and the example meets its independent oracle.
tasks.negative_case: An unsupported interpreter or missing binary dependency produces an actionable diagnosis rather than a successful import claim.

tasks.title: Determine whether a planned study is supported
tasks.user_need: A user must know execution limits before investing in an experiment.
tasks.inputs: Queries for supported models, operations, precision, derivatives, devices and known limits.
tasks.required_output: Machine-readable capability answers with version, scope and fallback policy.
tasks.acceptance: Answers agree with executable positive and negative probes; unknown support is explicit and no unavailable device is reported as tested.
tasks.negative_case: A requested feature absent from a selected backend is rejected or explicitly transformed before execution.

tasks.title: Learn a complete workflow from documentation
tasks.user_need: A learner needs a correct mental model and an executable example.
tasks.inputs: A frozen tutorial with specified prerequisites, wire order, parameters and expected outputs.
tasks.required_output: A reproduced artifact and a structured record of setup or interpretation obstacles.
tasks.acceptance: A reviewer following only the declared instructions reproduces the expected result; documentation states conventions and all required dependencies.
tasks.negative_case: A convention-sensitive example distinguishes control/target and wire significance rather than relying only on a symmetric Bell state.

tasks.title: Configure local and remote execution deliberately
tasks.user_need: An engineer needs to choose an account and target without accidental submissions or credential exposure.
tasks.inputs: Dummy credentials, mocked accounts, target settings, denied permissions and an explicit submission authorization policy.
tasks.required_output: A configuration or dry-run artifact, redacted diagnostics and an auditable submission decision.
tasks.acceptance: Dry-run and import paths make no execution submission; unauthorized paths fail; dummy secrets never appear in declared logs or persisted artifacts.
tasks.negative_case: Invalid credentials and a missing authorization flag cannot trigger an automatic paid retry.

tasks.title: Integrate a new provider or computation component
tasks.user_need: An integration engineer needs a supported extension path without modifying core internals.
tasks.inputs: A minimal contract-conforming stub plus malformed operations, outputs and provider errors.
tasks.required_output: An extension, boundary diagnostics and a result carrying component provenance.
tasks.acceptance: The documented extension interface accepts the valid component, rejects malformed records and preserves program/result conventions and structured failures.
tasks.negative_case: A plugin returning a different wire order or truncated output is detected, not accepted as a successful result.

tasks.title: Build and reuse a parameterized algorithm
tasks.user_need: An algorithm researcher needs one program evaluated at many parameter points without semantic changes.
tasks.inputs: A generated program with shared parameters, noncommuting gates, unused wires and several complete bindings.
tasks.required_output: An inspectable reusable program and correctly ordered outputs for each binding.
tasks.acceptance: All parameter occurrences use the specified binding; outputs match independent small-instance references and reusing a program does not leak state between runs.
tasks.negative_case: Missing, extra or shape-incompatible bindings are diagnosed explicitly.

tasks.title: Compose controlled and inverted subroutines with clean workspace
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs arithmetic or an oracle usable coherently inside a larger algorithm.
tasks.inputs: A bounded arithmetic/predicate specification, allowed ancillas, control conditions and promised workspace postcondition.
tasks.required_output: A controlled composable subroutine and workspace/resource report.
tasks.acceptance: For exhaustive bounded basis inputs and superposition checks, the action, phase and control behavior match the specification and clean ancillas are restored within the declared tolerance.
tasks.negative_case: Dirty ancillas, control-dependent phase errors and out-of-domain inputs are not hidden by checking only output probabilities.

tasks.title: Prepare a declared input state or data encoding
tasks.user_need: A user needs state preparation whose normalization, approximation and cost are explicit.
tasks.inputs: Basis, sparse and dense amplitude inputs plus an encoding convention, resource limit and approximation budget.
tasks.required_output: A prepared state or executable preparation routine with its cost and error disclosure.
tasks.acceptance: Small cases agree with independent amplitudes up to a single permitted global phase; normalization and approximation bounds are met and preparation cost is included.
tasks.negative_case: Zero-norm, nonfinite or dimensionally inconsistent input is rejected without silent normalization that changes the task.

tasks.title: Express a measurement-dependent algorithm
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs feed-forward, reset and bounded iterative behavior rather than static terminal measurement only.
tasks.inputs: Teleportation, repeat-until-success or phase-estimation fixtures with branch tables, register mapping and termination budget.
tasks.required_output: Execution traces and joint classical/quantum outcome statistics.
tasks.acceptance: Reachable branches match an independently enumerated small model; reset and termination semantics hold; unsupported target profiles are identified before submission.
tasks.negative_case: Reordered classical bits, an unbounded loop and an unsupported conditional operation cannot silently become a static circuit.

tasks.title: Express a mixed-dimensional quantum experiment
tasks.user_need: A researcher studying higher-dimensional systems needs dimensions preserved throughout execution.
tasks.inputs: A mixed qubit/qutrit register, level-selective gates and an explicit basis-index mapping.
tasks.required_output: An inspectable program and amplitudes or probabilities in the declared product basis.
tasks.acceptance: Dimensions, operation arity and indexing match a direct small-matrix oracle and normalization is preserved.
tasks.negative_case: An operation addressing a nonexistent level or a qubit-only backend is rejected rather than padded or relabeled silently.

tasks.title: Verify an ideal algorithm against an independent oracle
tasks.user_need: A developer needs to distinguish numerical implementation faults from algorithm design faults.
tasks.inputs: Small circuits with complex amplitudes, nonlocal controls, permutations and declared global-phase rules.
tasks.required_output: Output states and a verification certificate identifying the tested input space.
tasks.acceptance: Exhaustive basis plus interference tests or full small-unitary comparison meet the frozen error budget; any larger probe-only evidence is labeled as such.
tasks.negative_case: A relative phase or control/target reversal must fail even when one initial-state probability distribution happens to agree.

tasks.title: Verify sampling and register interpretation
tasks.user_need: A user needs samples that represent the declared measurement rather than a convenient output encoding.
tasks.inputs: Known discrete distributions with sparse support, multiple registers and nontrivial measurement maps.
tasks.required_output: Samples or counts with exact shot totals and explicit register conventions.
tasks.acceptance: Frozen equivalence tests meet the distribution tolerance with declared power and multiplicity control; shot conservation and mapping are exact.
tasks.negative_case: Counts, quasi-probabilities and postselected samples cannot be interchanged without type and denominator disclosure.

tasks.title: Check that a program rewrite preserves intended behavior
tasks.user_need: A compiler or algorithm developer needs evidence that an optimization preserves more than a single test output.
tasks.inputs: Original and transformed programs, permitted approximation, logical permutation and dynamic execution profile.
tasks.required_output: A comparison artifact stating exact, bounded numerical or sampled verification scope.
tasks.acceptance: For the prescribed small oracle domain, states or branch instruments match after only declared mapping/phase corrections; approximate changes remain within budget.
tasks.negative_case: An optimizer cannot erase terminal measurements, change branch probabilities or rely on an undisclosed initial-state assumption.

tasks.title: Validate a declared quantum channel or state transformation
tasks.user_need: A user needs valid mixed-state operations, including when errors are subtle.
tasks.inputs: Small channels with a declared representation and physicality contract, including entangled reference inputs.
tasks.required_output: Evolved states plus trace, positivity and representation checks.
tasks.acceptance: Declared physical channels preserve trace and positivity within budget and agree with a direct small channel oracle; nonphysical algebraic maps are labeled separately.
tasks.negative_case: A trace-changing map cannot be made valid by silent renormalization, and an invalid physical-channel declaration must fail.

tasks.title: Locate the stage and cause of an invalid experiment
tasks.user_need: A user needs actionable failure evidence to repair a workflow.
tasks.inputs: Invalid dimensions, bindings, unsupported operations, resource limits and injected execution/result faults.
tasks.required_output: A stage-specific failure record with reproducible input and redacted context.
tasks.acceptance: Each injected fault is classified at the correct boundary; no failure is represented as an empty successful result or silent fallback.
tasks.negative_case: A provider outage or missing dependency must remain distinguishable from an incorrect computed result.

tasks.title: Lower an algorithm into an executable instruction set
tasks.user_need: A device user needs every operation expressed in a target-supported form.
tasks.inputs: A fixed target basis, symbolic and numeric programs, synthesis tolerance and ancilla budget.
tasks.required_output: A legal lowered program with preserved semantics and resource counts.
tasks.acceptance: Every emitted operation satisfies the target contract; small-instance semantics and synthesis error pass; symbolic parameters and global-phase conventions are preserved.
tasks.negative_case: An unsupported gate cannot pass merely because an external simulator can execute it.

tasks.title: Map a logical algorithm to constrained connectivity
tasks.user_need: A user needs executable interactions with correct final logical results.
tasks.inputs: Frozen line, grid, irregular and all-to-all graphs; nonlocal circuits; placement policy and compile budget.
tasks.required_output: A routed program, initial/final mappings and logical result reconstruction.
tasks.acceptance: Every interaction is legal and reconstructed small-instance outputs match the original; routing quality is evaluated only after these gates pass.
tasks.negative_case: A final permutation, direction constraint or disconnected target cannot be ignored.

tasks.title: Schedule a program under timing and shared-resource constraints
tasks.user_need: An experimenter needs a schedule that can actually run on the declared device.
tasks.inputs: Instruction durations, alignment, conflicts, classical latency, dependencies and a frozen calibration snapshot.
tasks.required_output: A schedule with unit-tagged durations and conflict/critical-path evidence.
tasks.acceptance: All dependency, alignment and shared-resource constraints hold; duration accounting matches an independent schedule validator.
tasks.negative_case: Illegal overlaps and incompatible time units cannot be repaired silently or excluded from reported duration.

function_conditions.F15.02: Required when the frozen instance includes the pulse applicability tag.

tasks.title: Choose a compiler configuration under a practical budget
tasks.user_need: A user needs a useful quality-versus-latency choice rather than the smallest circuit at unlimited cost.
tasks.inputs: A frozen circuit distribution, target, seed set, wall-time/memory budgets and common quality metrics.
tasks.required_output: Feasible compile results and a quality/time Pareto surface including failed and censored runs.
tasks.acceptance: Semantic and target checks pass first; all tuning and search cost is recorded; only results within the predeclared budget enter that budget cohort.
tasks.negative_case: A timeout, best-of-many hidden seed search or target-specific gate-count convention cannot be presented as a fair win.

tasks.title: Determine feasibility before executing a target-incompatible program
tasks.user_need: A user needs an explicit explanation when a chosen device cannot carry the experiment.
tasks.inputs: Targets with insufficient wires, unsupported control flow, forbidden operations or incompatible timing.
tasks.required_output: A feasibility decision, constraint diagnostics and any explicitly authorized transformation proposal.
tasks.acceptance: Feasible fixtures compile legally; infeasible fixtures identify the violated constraints before execution; emulation or changed semantics require disclosure and cohort separation.
tasks.negative_case: A compiler must not silently switch provider, discard control flow or increase the requested error budget.

tasks.title: Compute only the amplitudes or probabilities needed by a study
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs selected outputs without paying for unnecessary output materialization.
tasks.inputs: A program, nonzero initial state and selected basis indices with a fixed representation/precision contract.
tasks.required_output: Indexed amplitudes or probabilities with execution and output costs separated.
tasks.acceptance: Values match the small reference and indexing contract; output volume and any full-state materialization are disclosed.
tasks.negative_case: Selected-index order and an unused-wire permutation cannot change the interpreted answer.

tasks.title: Evaluate a large observable collection correctly
tasks.user_need: A scientist needs energies and correlations containing many terms, often sharing a state.
tasks.inputs: Pauli or sparse observable sums with coefficients, support patterns and exact or shot-based execution mode.
tasks.required_output: All requested expectations with correct coefficient, basis and covariance handling.
tasks.acceptance: Exact outputs meet the numerical oracle; sampled outputs meet the specified statistical equivalence contract; all state preparations and shots are charged.
tasks.negative_case: Dropping small terms or independently normalizing coefficients requires an explicit approximation contract.

tasks.title: Compute subsystem information without changing subsystem identity
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs entanglement or local-state information on explicitly selected subsystems.
tasks.inputs: Entangled pure/mixed fixtures, noncontiguous subsystem lists and a basis-order convention.
tasks.required_output: Reduced states, correlations or entropy under specified conventions.
tasks.acceptance: Partial traces and derived quantities match independent small references; trace, dimensions and eigenvalue handling satisfy the contract.
tasks.negative_case: A subsystem permutation or entropy unit mismatch must be detected rather than hidden by a symmetric test state.

tasks.title: Work with a Hamiltonian without unnecessary dense expansion
tasks.user_need: A user needs algebra and action on large structured operators within memory limits.
tasks.inputs: Sparse or Pauli-sum Hamiltonians, symmetry sectors, coefficient scales and memory budgets.
tasks.required_output: Operator action, expectations or simplified representations with equivalent semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Small cases match dense algebra; declared sparsity and memory limits are respected, and transformations retain coefficients and constants.
tasks.negative_case: A constant energy offset, canceled term or symmetry-sector restriction cannot be lost.

tasks.title: Evaluate a parameter sweep without cross-run contamination
tasks.user_need: A study needs many parameter points or initial states with predictable ordering and reuse.
tasks.inputs: Distinct parameter/initial-state batches, repeated execution and serial reference cases.
tasks.required_output: Ordered outputs with explicit cache/compilation reuse and batch semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Every output matches its corresponding serial reference; cache invalidation works after changed parameters, program or device.
tasks.negative_case: Broadcasting one parameter vector into all samples or reusing a stale compiled binding must fail.

tasks.title: Simulate an extended low-entanglement system
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs large-system local observables that do not require a full dense state.
tasks.inputs: A low-entanglement circuit family, requested observables and a prescribed error/resource budget.
tasks.required_output: Local results and representation/truncation diagnostics.
tasks.acceptance: Small overlaps agree with exact references; larger results meet the declared observable or certified-bound contract, and no unrequested dense state is materialized.
tasks.negative_case: A large wire count with an uncontrolled observable error is not a successful capacity result.

tasks.title: Determine where an approximate representation stops being reliable
tasks.user_need: A user needs to recognize approximation failure rather than receive plausible-looking numbers.
tasks.inputs: Matched low/high-entanglement families, escalating depth and truncation budgets.
tasks.required_output: Accuracy/resource curves with explicit failure or uncertainty boundaries.
tasks.acceptance: Measured reference errors stay within the accepted region; outside it, violations remain visible; discarded weight is not treated as a universal observable-error certificate.
tasks.negative_case: Renormalization alone cannot turn a strongly truncated state into evidence of a correct computation.

tasks.title: Compute a tensor-network output within a memory ceiling
tasks.user_need: A simulator user needs a feasible contraction strategy whose planning cost is known.
tasks.inputs: Network families, requested outputs, contraction-search budget and memory ceiling.
tasks.required_output: A contraction/slicing plan, planning log and validated output.
tasks.acceptance: Planning plus execution stays within its cohort budget; output passes the independent feasible-size oracle and all slices are combined with the correct weights.
tasks.negative_case: A cached plan from another topology or omitted slices must not produce a successful result.

tasks.title: Evolve a many-body state with controlled discretization and truncation
tasks.user_need: A scientist needs physically meaningful time-series outputs with both integration and representation errors controlled.
tasks.inputs: A Hamiltonian, initial state, time grid, boundary conditions and error budget.
tasks.required_output: Observable trajectories with step-size and truncation diagnostics.
tasks.acceptance: Small cases agree with exact evolution; refinement studies separate time-discretization and representation effects and satisfy the requested observable tolerance.
tasks.negative_case: Changing boundaries or the time unit cannot be used to obtain an easier but different evolution.

tasks.title: Select a representation for a requested scientific output
tasks.user_need: A user needs a practical answer at target accuracy, not the same internal algorithm in every implementation.
tasks.inputs: A fixed problem/output contract, candidate representation policies and total selection budget.
tasks.required_output: A validated output with method choice, selection cost and approximation provenance.
tasks.acceptance: The output meets the common error target; all method-selection runs are counted and comparisons distinguish matched-method from best-available workflows.
tasks.negative_case: An automatic fallback to a different precision or approximation cannot remain undisclosed.

tasks.title: Obtain trustworthy derivatives of a quantum model
tasks.user_need: An optimizer user needs derivatives with correct shared-parameter and complex-output conventions.
tasks.inputs: Small circuit, finite-mode and controlled-Hamiltonian fixtures with independent analytic/directional references, shared parameters, vector outputs and explicit units/complex-output conventions.
tasks.required_output: Gradients or derivative products with method, shape and cost provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic cases and independent directional checks meet mixed absolute/relative tolerances, including near-zero components; parameter sharing is accumulated correctly.
tasks.negative_case: A detached parameter, transposed Jacobian or conjugation error must fail even when optimization happens to improve the loss.

tasks.title: Train a minibatched hybrid quantum/classical model
tasks.user_need: A practitioner needs learning across a classical/quantum boundary with correct batching.
tasks.inputs: A fixed dataset/split, model, initialization, objective and compute budget, with serial small-batch references.
tasks.required_output: Training traces, held-out evaluation and resource/call accounting.
tasks.acceptance: Gradients cross every declared trainable boundary; batch outputs match serial references; the frozen convergence or quality target is met under the total budget.
tasks.negative_case: Averaging all examples before the quantum layer or training on held-out data is rejected.

tasks.title: Converge a variational objective under a fixed budget
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs successful convergence, not merely fast optimizer iterations.
tasks.inputs: A declared cost operator, ansatz, parameter domain, initializations and target objective interval.
tasks.required_output: Independent-seed optimization outcomes and complete objective/gradient call traces.
tasks.acceptance: Successful runs meet the frozen objective target within budget; seed failures and tuning cost remain in the success-rate and cost report.
tasks.negative_case: Changing optimizer stopping rules or retaining only the best initialization cannot change the primary cohort after results are seen.

tasks.title: Use curvature or derivative products in a learning routine
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs curvature-aware optimization or sensitivity analysis with a valid derivative graph.
tasks.inputs: Small objectives with reference Hessians/JVPs/VJPs and a fixed outer optimization or sensitivity computation.
tasks.required_output: Derivative products and a correct enclosing workflow result.
tasks.acceptance: Independent small references and directional identities pass; unsupported derivative orders or backends are explicit instead of returning detached or zero values.
tasks.negative_case: A first-derivative-only implementation cannot be presented as higher-order support through an unreported finite-difference wrapper.

tasks.title: Optimize a noisy sampled model with a shot budget
tasks.user_need: A user needs learning whose statistical cost is accounted for.
tasks.inputs: A fixed sampled objective, noise/execution model, independent seeds, shot budget and target success criterion.
tasks.required_output: Training outcomes with derivative variance, total shots and all shifted evaluations.
tasks.acceptance: Declared estimator bias/variance and task success satisfy the frozen statistical contract; no analytic expectation is substituted for sampled calls.
tasks.negative_case: Adaptive shot allocation and discarded trajectories must be charged and reproducible.

tasks.title: Estimate molecular ground or excited-state energies
tasks.user_need: A chemistry researcher needs energies for the same molecular problem, with all conventions explicit.
tasks.inputs: Frozen geometry/units, basis, charge/spin, active space, Hamiltonian constants, state/spectral target and reference uncertainty.
tasks.required_output: Energies, state/optimization evidence and end-to-end preparation/evaluation costs.
tasks.acceptance: The requested total or electronic-energy convention and state target match the reference; error plus reference uncertainty fits the budget and all preprocessing/calls are recorded.
tasks.negative_case: A different active space, omitted nuclear constant or ground-state answer to an excited-state request is a different task, not a speedup.

tasks.title: Predict a many-body dynamics or correlation study
tasks.user_need: A scientist needs a physically specified trajectory rather than a circuit-runtime number.
tasks.inputs: Lattice/graph, local Hilbert dimensions, spin/fermion/boson encoding, couplings, units, boundaries, initial state, output times and selected correlations.
tasks.required_output: A time series and an auditable total error/resource account.
tasks.acceptance: Small reference and larger convergence cases meet the prescribed observable error; constants, boundary conditions and time grids are identical across compared workflows.
tasks.negative_case: Selecting only easy early-time points or omitting correlation terms must remain a failed/incomplete study.

tasks.title: Solve a constrained optimization instance and decode the answer
tasks.user_need: A practitioner needs feasible solutions in the original application variables.
tasks.inputs: Frozen instance distribution, constraints, objective, classical reference or bound and resource budget.
tasks.required_output: Decoded solutions, independently recomputed objectives, feasibility and success distributions.
tasks.acceptance: Every claimed solution is checked in the original problem; success meets the predeclared quality/feasibility target and includes formulation, search and repair costs.
tasks.negative_case: A low penalized energy is not evidence of original-problem feasibility; classical repair cannot be hidden.

function_conditions.F18.04: Required when the frozen instance includes the annealing applicability tag.

tasks.title: Estimate a phase or amplitude with complete oracle accounting
tasks.user_need: An algorithm researcher needs an inference result at specified accuracy and confidence.

tasks.required_output: An estimate, interval and full controlled-oracle/preparation/measurement cost.
tasks.acceptance: The inference error and interval coverage meet the frozen contract over the prescribed instance ensemble; oracle and classical postprocessing costs are included.
tasks.negative_case: Counting a controlled high-power oracle as one free elementary operation cannot support an end-to-end efficiency claim.

tasks.title: Extract a useful observable from a quantum linear-algebra routine
tasks.user_need: A user needs an interpretable answer, not only a normalized state encoding an unknown solution.
tasks.inputs: A bounded matrix problem, conditioning promise, preparation/block-encoding contract and explicitly requested observable or solution output.
tasks.required_output: The requested classical quantity or declared quantum-state output with all success probabilities.
tasks.acceptance: The specified output matches the independent reference within budget; conditioning, postselection, preparation and readout costs are disclosed.
tasks.negative_case: Comparing quantum-state preparation time to a full classical-vector output is disallowed unless the output contracts are made identical.

tasks.title: Predict outputs of a declared noisy experiment
tasks.user_need: A noise researcher needs consistent channel placement and sampled or exact outputs.
tasks.inputs: Frozen channel locations/order, noise parameters, input program, measurement and trajectory/shot policy.
tasks.required_output: Mixed-state observables or distributions with solver/sampling metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Small density-matrix references and trajectory equivalence tests pass; finite-sampling uncertainty and exact-versus-sampled cohorts are distinct.
tasks.negative_case: Moving noise before rather than after a noncommuting gate is a changed experiment and must fail.

tasks.title: Integrate a time-dependent open quantum system
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs driven/dissipative dynamics with interpretable physical units and solver error.
tasks.inputs: Hamiltonian/dissipators, units, frame, initial density matrix, output times and tolerances.
tasks.required_output: State or observable trajectories with integration diagnostics.
tasks.acceptance: Analytically solvable and independent small-solver fixtures satisfy error budgets; trace/physicality checks and refinement tests expose integration failure.
tasks.negative_case: A frame, rate-unit or collapse-operator normalization mismatch cannot be hidden by rescaling the final curve.

function_conditions.F15.03: Required when the frozen instance includes the pulse applicability tag.

tasks.title: Correct measurement bias with accounted calibration uncertainty
tasks.user_need: An experimenter needs to know whether readout correction improves the requested estimate.
tasks.inputs: Calibration and evaluation datasets kept separate, an estimator, target observable and total shot budget.
tasks.required_output: Raw and mitigated estimates, uncertainty, conditioning diagnostics and calibration cost.
tasks.acceptance: Known-channel fixtures satisfy the declared bias/coverage target; calibration uncertainty and any negative quasi-probabilities are handled explicitly.
tasks.negative_case: Clipping negative weights and silently renormalizing them cannot be claimed as an unbiased correction.

tasks.title: Assess extrapolation or cancellation at matched total cost
tasks.user_need: A user needs evidence of practical mitigation benefit after its statistical overhead.
tasks.inputs: A declared mitigation method, scaling/quasi-probability assumptions, raw baseline, held-out fixtures and total budget.
tasks.required_output: Raw/mitigated errors, intervals, failure cases and all additional programs/shots.
tasks.acceptance: At matched total cost the predeclared quality criterion is evaluated with appropriate uncertainty; scaling and cancellation assumptions are independently checked.
tasks.negative_case: A zero-noise reference used in fitting cannot also be presented as unseen validation evidence.

tasks.title: Validate a frozen device or noise model on unseen experiments
tasks.user_need: A user needs to know where a predictive model generalizes beyond calibration data.
tasks.inputs: Versioned calibration/training data, a frozen model, disjoint circuits/settings and acquisition windows.
tasks.required_output: Predictions, held-out residuals, uncertainty and a declared validity region.
tasks.acceptance: The frozen predictive contract is evaluated only on held-out data; calibration age, drift and unsupported regions are retained, with failures reported.
tasks.negative_case: Retrospective fitting on evaluation counts cannot be labeled prospective validation.

tasks.title: Select a device capable of a planned experiment
tasks.user_need: An experimenter needs to choose an accessible target whose actual profile matches the program.
tasks.inputs: Mocked target rosters, availability/access responses and programs with model/timing/control requirements.
tasks.required_output: A target decision and compatibility evidence without a submission.
tasks.acceptance: Declared capabilities match validation fixtures; unavailable, inaccessible or incompatible targets are distinguished and do not trigger substitute execution.
tasks.negative_case: A provider adapter being installed is not evidence that the user has hardware access.

tasks.title: Prepare and submit an explicitly authorized experiment batch
tasks.user_need: A user needs predictable submission scope and a traceable acquisition request.
tasks.inputs: A frozen plan, target snapshot, parameter bindings, shot limits and explicit authorization.
tasks.required_output: A validated preview and, only when authorized, job identities bound to the exact submitted payloads.
tasks.acceptance: The submitted payload, bindings and budgets match the approved preview; uncertainty in provider cost is explicit and a stub verifies zero unapproved submissions.
tasks.negative_case: Changed shots, extra calibration circuits or retries beyond the approved policy require a new explicit decision.

tasks.title: Recover asynchronous or partially completed work
tasks.user_need: A user needs to resume a study after interruption without losing or duplicating paid work.
tasks.inputs: Recorded job IDs, partial result pages, timeouts, cancellation states and ambiguous submission acknowledgments.
tasks.required_output: A reconciled job ledger and complete/partial results with explicit unresolved states.
tasks.acceptance: Retrieval reconstructs available results and distinguishes unknown submission from failure; no duplicate job is created outside the predeclared retry/authorization policy.
tasks.negative_case: A client timeout after server acceptance cannot automatically become a second paid submission.

tasks.title: Recover logical observations from compiled device results
tasks.user_need: A scientist needs counts attributed to the right program, binding and logical subsystem.
tasks.inputs: Batches with distinct IDs, unused wires, final layout permutations, multiple registers and provider result order changes.
tasks.required_output: Canonical logical result records plus the original provider records and mappings.
tasks.acceptance: Every result is matched to its exact program/binding and logical bits; all shot totals and partial/missing records reconcile without positional guesses.
tasks.negative_case: Reordered publications or provider-endian strings must not silently swap experiment identities.

tasks.title: Repeat an experiment while retaining acquisition context
tasks.user_need: A user needs to distinguish software differences from device drift and acquisition conditions.
tasks.inputs: A repeated protocol with acquisition windows, calibration snapshots, interleaved ordering and frozen software settings.
tasks.required_output: A run series with time/device context and separately reported software and acquisition effects.
tasks.acceptance: The same task/budget is preserved; timestamp and calibration provenance are retained and any missing context limits the permitted comparison claim.
tasks.negative_case: Queue time or a hardware fidelity change cannot be assigned to SDK computation speed without a controlled software measurement.

tasks.title: Construct and validate a code with named logical observables
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs code definitions whose algebra and logical conventions can be checked.
tasks.inputs: Check matrices or geometric code specifications, boundaries and named logical operators.
tasks.required_output: A code object or equivalent artifact with checks, labels and validation evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Commutation, dimensions, declared logical relations and small enumerated fixtures agree; a claimed distance is proved for the bounded fixture or explicitly left unverified.
tasks.negative_case: A noncommuting check set or an unsupported subsystem-code assumption must not be silently repaired.

tasks.title: Run repeated syndrome-extraction memory experiments
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs the full round/measurement history for logical-memory analysis.
tasks.inputs: A code, extraction schedule, round count, noise locations and detector/logical definitions.
tasks.required_output: Syndrome histories, detection events and logical-observable records.
tasks.acceptance: Noiseless and injected single-fault small fixtures match independent expected histories; measurement/reset order and round labels are preserved.
tasks.negative_case: Dropping an initial/final boundary event or shifting a measurement by one round must fail.

function_conditions.F14.02: Required when the frozen instance includes the qec applicability tag.

tasks.title: Build and sample an explicitly scoped detector error model
tasks.user_need: A decoder study needs a model that matches the declared circuit/noise assumptions.
tasks.inputs: A small extraction experiment, supported noise model, correlation policy and event/observable mapping.
tasks.required_output: A detector model, interchange artifact and sampled events with provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Independent enumerated faults and sampled distributions agree within contract; approximation and discarded correlations are explicit and round-trip semantics hold.
tasks.negative_case: An unsupported correlated error cannot be split into independent edges without a declared approximation.

tasks.title: Evaluate a decoder on held-out detector events
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs a logical error/latency tradeoff with the same underlying decoding problem.
tasks.inputs: Frozen detector events, logical labels, model, noise rate, training/tuning separation and latency budget.
tasks.required_output: Predictions, logical failure intervals, latency distribution and unmatched-case records.
tasks.acceptance: Predictions are scored on held-out events; latency includes specified preprocessing boundaries, and zero observed failures still receive a nonzero uncertainty bound.
tasks.negative_case: Decoder training/tuning samples cannot leak into evaluation, and unmatched syndromes cannot be dropped.

tasks.title: Estimate resources for a specified logical computation
tasks.user_need: A user needs transparent fault-tolerant resource assumptions rather than an unexplained qubit number.
tasks.inputs: A logical program, synthesis precision, error budget, code/cycle assumptions and magic-state/resource model.
tasks.required_output: A resource ledger separating logical counts, synthesis, factories, physical assumptions and extrapolation.
tasks.acceptance: Small ledgers independently reconcile counts and budgets; all claimed physical resources follow the frozen model and no estimate is presented as demonstrated hardware performance.
tasks.negative_case: A logical T-count alone cannot be reported as total physical resource cost.

tasks.title: Express physical controls with explicit units and channels
tasks.user_need: A control researcher needs an unambiguous representation of a physical experiment.
tasks.inputs: Waveforms, ports/frames, calibration references, sample rate, amplitude limits and channel assignments.
tasks.required_output: A validated control program and exported waveform/metadata artifact.
tasks.acceptance: Units, frame changes, samples and channel associations survive inspection/export; constraints are independently checked.
tasks.negative_case: A frequency-unit mismatch, out-of-range sample or missing frame reference is rejected.

tasks.title: Schedule simultaneous and feedback-dependent control
tasks.user_need: An experimenter needs valid concurrent pulses and classical feedback timing.
tasks.inputs: A control program with channel conflicts, alignment, feedback latency and device timing constraints.
tasks.required_output: An executable schedule with conflict and dependency evidence.
tasks.acceptance: All constraints pass an independent schedule validator; effective rounded timings and any changed experiment are explicit.
tasks.negative_case: A feedback pulse cannot be scheduled before its measurement result exists.

function_conditions.F15.02: Required when the frozen instance includes the pulse applicability tag.

tasks.title: Predict a calibrated driven-system response
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs response predictions in the intended physical frame.
tasks.inputs: A driven Hamiltonian, dissipators, control samples, rotating-frame convention and output times.
tasks.required_output: States or observable traces with solver tolerances and frame metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic and independent small-system fixtures meet the observable/state budget; time-step refinement and frame conversion are checked.
tasks.negative_case: Dropping counter-rotating terms or changing frames requires an explicit approximation rather than a silent optimization.

tasks.title: Optimize a pulse under physical and evaluation constraints
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs a control solution that meets a physical objective without violating device limits.
tasks.inputs: A target operation/response, model or authorized device path, pulse constraints, initialization and evaluation budget.
tasks.required_output: A constrained control solution, objective trace and held-out validation.
tasks.acceptance: The final control satisfies all physical constraints and the frozen quality target; all evaluations are counted and modeled versus measured evidence is distinct.
tasks.negative_case: A high modeled fidelity outside allowed amplitudes or bandwidth is not a valid solution.

tasks.title: Use the correct calibration for a gate-level experiment
tasks.user_need: An experimenter needs calibrated controls associated with the correct gate, device and acquisition context.
tasks.inputs: Versioned gate/control definitions, parameter domains, target IDs and stale or incompatible calibration fixtures.
tasks.required_output: A resolved gate-to-control binding and complete calibration provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Compatible bindings preserve declared gate behavior on the small model; stale or mismatched definitions are rejected or explicitly flagged under a frozen policy.
tasks.negative_case: A calibration from a different device or clock cannot be treated as current without disclosure.

function_conditions.F15.05: Required when the frozen instance includes the pulse applicability tag.

tasks.title: Describe a native analog experiment
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs to specify geometry and time-dependent interactions directly.
tasks.inputs: Sites, species, initial configuration, coupling law, boundaries, fields and physical units.
tasks.required_output: An inspectable analog program with explicit interpolation and control semantics.
tasks.acceptance: Geometry, interactions, units and schedule endpoints match independent small fixtures; no gate-model discretization is imposed without an explicit method declaration.
tasks.negative_case: Changing lattice boundaries or silently converting a piecewise schedule to a different interpolation changes the task.

tasks.title: Compute observables of a native analog evolution
tasks.user_need: A scientist needs predicted observables or samples for an analog study.
tasks.inputs: A fixed analog program, initial state, observable/time grid and solver/error budget.
tasks.required_output: Observable trajectories or samples with method and uncertainty metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Small direct-Hamiltonian references and larger declared convergence checks pass; approximation, loss and sampling assumptions remain explicit.
tasks.negative_case: An easier gate approximation cannot replace the requested evolution outside the agreed discretization budget.

tasks.title: Prepare an analog program for a constrained device
tasks.user_need: A device user needs physical geometry and controls that the target can implement.
tasks.inputs: A program plus spacing, placement, field, slew-rate, clock and local/global control limits.
tasks.required_output: A legal target program with a record of rounding, discretization and unsupported requirements.
tasks.acceptance: Independent target checks pass and the induced program change remains inside the declared tolerance; infeasible programs are diagnosed before submission.
tasks.negative_case: Unavailable local addressing cannot silently become a global field.

tasks.title: Interpret analog measurements with loading and loss records
tasks.user_need: A user needs an honest denominator when particles are absent or lost.
tasks.inputs: Raw loading/pre/post-measurement records, a frozen postselection rule and desired correlations.
tasks.required_output: Raw and conditional estimates, loss fractions, acceptance denominators and uncertainty.
tasks.acceptance: Counts reconcile across loading, loss and selection; both unconditional and conditional meanings are explicit and the estimator follows the frozen rule.
tasks.negative_case: Discarding loss events without reporting them cannot improve a success metric invisibly.

tasks.title: Compare analog schedules for the same physical objective
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs a schedule comparison tied to an unchanged physical problem.
tasks.inputs: A physical objective, admissible schedule class, model/target constraints and tuning/evaluation budget.
tasks.required_output: Schedules, objective/feasibility distributions and total cost.
tasks.acceptance: All compared schedules solve the same objective and satisfy identical constraints; selection cost, solver approximation and held-out evaluation are disclosed.
tasks.negative_case: Changing interaction strength or allowed controls to make one schedule easier is a different cohort.

tasks.title: Prepare and transform a mode-based input state
tasks.user_need: A photonic researcher needs mode order and quadrature conventions preserved.
tasks.inputs: Vacuum, coherent, squeezed and small non-Gaussian states; transformations; declared hbar/quadrature convention.
tasks.required_output: State moments or small-basis outputs with convention metadata.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic moments and independent small fixtures agree after only declared convention conversions; mode identities and physical units are preserved.
tasks.negative_case: A vacuum variance or displacement convention mismatch cannot be hidden by rescaling only the plotted output.

tasks.title: Compute Gaussian optical transformations and correlations
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs scalable Gaussian observables or sampling with correct covariance semantics.
tasks.inputs: An interferometer, Gaussian inputs/channels and requested first/second moments or measured distributions.
tasks.required_output: Moments, covariance or samples in the declared ordering.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic small references, physical covariance constraints and the applicable statistical equivalence contract pass.
tasks.negative_case: An incorrect symplectic or mode permutation must fail despite preserved scalar normalization.

tasks.title: Compute a non-Gaussian process with controlled Fock truncation
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs a non-Gaussian result with a justified cutoff.
tasks.inputs: A finite-mode non-Gaussian circuit, cutoff/refinement sequence, output quantity and error budget.
tasks.required_output: Requested outputs, truncation diagnostics and convergence evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Small independent Fock references and cutoff refinement meet the output-error target; discarded probability and any renormalization remain visible.
tasks.negative_case: A truncated result cannot be reported as exact merely because the retained vector has been normalized.

tasks.title: Analyze photon-counting or quadrature observations
tasks.user_need: A user needs measurement records with detector, loss and postselection meaning intact.
tasks.inputs: Homodyne/heterodyne or number-resolving fixtures, detector/loss assumptions, sample units and a selection rule.
tasks.required_output: Typed measurement outcomes and raw/conditional estimates with uncertainty.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic or independent finite-size distributions satisfy the frozen statistical contract; mode order, units and all selection denominators reconcile.
tasks.negative_case: A continuous quadrature record cannot be treated as a discrete photon count or silently binned with an undisclosed rule.

tasks.title: Transfer a mode program to another execution boundary
tasks.user_need: A user needs an optical program to retain its transformation, measurement and feed-forward intent.

tasks.acceptance: Small observables or instruments agree after declared conversions and target checks pass; unsupported non-Gaussian/adaptive features are rejected explicitly.
tasks.negative_case: A mode cutoff, measurement type or feed-forward rule cannot disappear during interchange.

tasks.acceptance: Exhaustive small assignments reconcile energies, offsets and feasibility; domain conversions and penalty assumptions are explicit.

tasks.title: Embed a logical model onto a physical topology

tasks.title: Run a controlled annealing sampling study
tasks.user_need: A practitioner needs results tied to the actual schedule, gauge and sampler type.

tasks.title: Evaluate feasibility and postprocessing honestly

tasks.title: Compare hybrid optimization at a matched end-to-end budget
tasks.user_need: A practitioner needs a defensible quality/cost comparison for a solver that mixes resources.
