tasks.required_output: Feasibility/quality success curves and a complete resource-accounting boundary.
tasks.acceptance: The output contract and budget are shared; inaccessible internal QPU/classical breakdown is labeled unknown, while observable end-to-end cost and failures remain reported.
tasks.negative_case: A hidden classical search or unknown internal QPU time cannot support a claimed quantum speedup or per-QPU efficiency.

tasks.title: Run the same output contract on supported compute devices
tasks.user_need: An operator needs to know which devices and precisions actually complete a study.
tasks.inputs: Frozen outputs/accuracy targets, CPU/accelerator configurations and supported precision combinations.
tasks.required_output: Per-device correctness, actual execution path, memory and timing records.
tasks.acceptance: The same output/accuracy contract passes; device execution is verified, asynchronous work is synchronized and any host fallback is explicit.
tasks.negative_case: A GPU label with CPU execution or a lower-precision result outside tolerance cannot count as successful acceleration.

tasks.title: Expand a single computation through distributed state or tensor partitioning
tasks.user_need: A user needs a larger single problem to fit across multiple resources.
tasks.inputs: Fixed strong-scaling and separately defined capacity/weak-scaling workloads, partition policy and output contract.
tasks.required_output: Validated distributed outputs with partition and communication evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Small overlaps match an independent reference; shards or slices jointly represent one computation and resource/communication measurements include gathering the requested output.
tasks.negative_case: Replicated copies of a small state are not evidence of larger distributed-state capacity.

tasks.title: Increase throughput of independent experiments or training examples
tasks.user_need: A study needs higher throughput without changing individual outputs.
tasks.inputs: Independent circuits, seeds, parameter batches or shot partitions with a frozen serial reference.
tasks.required_output: An ordered reconciled result set and total-work/resource ledger.
tasks.acceptance: All independent outputs match their serial contracts; random streams, work assignment and result ordering are correct and throughput is not described as single-state capacity.
tasks.negative_case: Dropped, duplicated or accidentally correlated work units must fail accounting or statistical checks.

tasks.title: Resume a computation or training run after interruption
tasks.user_need: An operator needs a long-running study to survive interruption without changing its meaning.
tasks.inputs: A fixed checkpoint point, model/optimizer/RNG state, partition configuration and declared failure injections.
tasks.required_output: A resumed run and comparison against an uninterrupted control.
tasks.acceptance: Required state is restored and final outputs/continuation match the frozen deterministic or statistical contract; replayed work and recovery cost are counted.
tasks.negative_case: Restoring weights while losing optimizer, random or parameter-binding state is not full training recovery.

tasks.title: Determine the largest completed study under real resource limits
tasks.user_need: A user needs a capacity boundary tied to meaningful outputs and acceptable error.
tasks.inputs: A predefined scale ladder, error target, memory/wall-time budget and stop policy.
tasks.required_output: Completed, timed-out, out-of-memory and inaccurate outcomes with telemetry.
tasks.acceptance: Capacity is the largest instance completing the same output/error contract within budget; resource-limit outcomes remain censored failures rather than missing rows.
tasks.negative_case: A large allocation, trivial initial state or omitted requested output cannot establish useful computational capacity.

tasks.title: Exchange a program through a declared standard/profile
tasks.user_need: An engineer needs another tool to understand the intended program.
tasks.inputs: Versioned interchange fixtures, parameters, classical records, timing features and an explicit supported profile.
tasks.required_output: Imported/exported programs and feature-level conversion diagnostics.
tasks.acceptance: Supported fixtures retain required semantics on independent bounded references; unsupported syntax/features are rejected with a precise profile boundary.
tasks.negative_case: Successful parsing of a program with dropped control or calibration blocks is not successful interchange.

tasks.title: Round-trip an artifact across different conventions
tasks.user_need: A user needs portability without hidden changes to wire, variable, unit or output meaning.
tasks.inputs: Asymmetric convention-sensitive fixtures, source/target maps and the required preservable metadata.
tasks.required_output: Round-trip artifacts plus an explicit preservation/loss report.
tasks.acceptance: Small reference outputs and required metadata agree after declared conversions; irrecoverable information loss is rejected or explicitly outside the round-trip contract.
tasks.negative_case: Byte equality alone is insufficient, while semantic equality cannot excuse losing required calibration or result provenance.

tasks.title: Reproduce a published software result from its evidence bundle
tasks.user_need: A reviewer needs to reproduce a claim without the original workstation or undisclosed settings.
tasks.inputs: An immutable evidence bundle with input/reference hashes, environment lock, commands, seeds, outputs and restrictions.
tasks.required_output: A replayed run, environment differences and checked result comparison.
tasks.acceptance: The declared reference and numerical/statistical contract can be checked from the bundle; missing access or artifacts are explicit and prevent a reproducible label.
tasks.negative_case: A screenshot, best runtime or mutable notebook link alone is not a replayable result.

tasks.title: Identify which components actually performed the work
tasks.user_need: A reviewer needs to attribute frontend, compiler, engine and external-service contributions accurately.
tasks.inputs: A workflow containing optional engines, derivative methods, compilation caches and intentional fallback conditions.
tasks.required_output: A component/version dependency chain and stage-level execution/cost evidence.
tasks.acceptance: Actual execution and fallback match telemetry/probes; all externally supplied work and cached setup costs are disclosed under the chosen measurement boundary.
tasks.negative_case: Two frontends using the same engine cannot be presented as independent engine implementations or independent numerical oracles.

tasks.title: Detect semantic or operational regressions after an upgrade
tasks.user_need: A maintainer needs to know whether upgrading preserves an existing study.
tasks.inputs: Frozen task/fixture versions, old/new dependency locks and declared compatibility promises.
tasks.required_output: A regression report separating changed semantics, environment failures and performance changes.
tasks.acceptance: The same frozen acceptance contracts are evaluated for both environments; migration requirements and intentional breaking changes remain visible.
tasks.negative_case: Changing the test inputs or dropping failed tasks during an upgrade invalidates a direct regression claim.

tasks.title: Estimate an observable with a specified uncertainty target
tasks.user_need: A scientist needs an estimate whose stated uncertainty is meaningful at finite sample size.
tasks.inputs: Typed raw observations, a fixed estimator, target error/confidence, independent seeds and a stopping policy.
tasks.required_output: An estimate, interval, denominator and a complete shot/call ledger.
tasks.acceptance: Known-distribution coverage and equivalence/power fixtures pass; zero counts and rare events receive valid uncertainty handling and sequential stopping follows the frozen protocol.
tasks.negative_case: A narrow plug-in interval at zero observed failures or an uncorrected repeated significance test must not pass.

tasks.title: Plan measurements for an energy or correlation target
tasks.user_need: A user needs an accurate many-term estimate at limited measurement cost.
tasks.inputs: An observable collection, allowed compatible-measurement groups, allocation policy and total shot budget.
tasks.required_output: Measurement programs, grouped outcomes, final estimates and covariance/cost accounting.
tasks.acceptance: The requested observable is unchanged; grouped-estimator bias/uncertainty satisfies the frozen contract and all pilot, calibration and evaluation shots are charged.
tasks.negative_case: Assuming grouped observables are statistically independent without justification can invalidate the uncertainty claim.

tasks.title: Reconstruct a state or process with validation beyond the fitted data
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs a reconstruction whose apparent fit is not confused with predictive validity.
tasks.inputs: Informationally specified measurements, physicality/model assumptions, noise and held-out validation fixtures.
tasks.required_output: A reconstruction, identifiability diagnostics, uncertainty and held-out predictions.
tasks.acceptance: Analytic/small references and held-out prediction criteria pass; underdetermined or nonidentifiable cases are explicit and physicality constraints are disclosed.
tasks.negative_case: A good in-sample fit cannot certify a unique state, process or global fidelity when the observations do not identify it.

tasks.title: Estimate a predefined observable family from reusable measurement records
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs a controlled way to reuse randomized measurements for multiple quantities.
tasks.inputs: A frozen randomized measurement scheme, observable family, reconstruction rule, seed and sample budget.
tasks.required_output: Per-observable estimates, simultaneous uncertainty and measurement provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Known small cases and repeated-seed coverage tests meet the family-wise error contract; observable selection and all measurement overhead are disclosed.
tasks.negative_case: Choosing only observables with favorable estimates after viewing the data cannot support the preregistered family claim.

tasks.title: Produce a scientific report that retains model failures and uncertainty
tasks.user_need: A user needs a report that communicates what the experiment does and does not establish.
tasks.inputs: Known identifiable and nonidentifiable fit fixtures, raw records, units, model assumptions and report schema.
tasks.required_output: Machine-readable and human-readable results retaining raw estimates, diagnostics and provenance.
tasks.acceptance: Units, uncertainty and raw-data links reconcile; unidentifiable fits and model mismatch are explicit; generated examples cannot be labeled as device measurements.
tasks.negative_case: Clipping a failed fit into a plausible parameter or dropping missing outcomes is a reporting failure.

tasks.title: Train and evaluate a quantum-kernel predictor
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs predictive utility of a quantum kernel measured on unseen data under a complete computation budget.
tasks.inputs: A frozen dataset/split, encoding, kernel definition, sampled or exact evaluation policy, regularization search space and classical comparison protocol.
tasks.required_output: Kernel matrices or predictions, train/validation/test results, conditioning diagnostics and all kernel/search costs.
tasks.acceptance: Small exact kernels match independent references; finite-shot uncertainty and any matrix repair are disclosed; the frozen held-out quality target is evaluated without test-set tuning and with all preprocessing and hyperparameter search charged.
tasks.negative_case: Repairing a sampled kernel, tuning on test labels or omitting classical training/search cost cannot improve the reported result invisibly.

tasks.title: Execute a measurement-based computation pattern
tasks.user_need: A researcher needs graph-state preparation, dependent measurement angles and byproduct corrections to implement a specified computation.
tasks.inputs: A bounded graph/measurement pattern, input/output vertices, measurement planes and angles, causal dependencies and correction/frame rules.
tasks.required_output: An executable pattern or semantics-preserving lowering, measurement histories and corrected logical outputs with resource accounting.
tasks.acceptance: All bounded reachable branches obey causality and produce the specified corrected logical map against an independent oracle; any postselection probability and lowering overhead are reported.
tasks.negative_case: Ignoring byproduct corrections, measuring before a dependency is available or silently postselecting successful branches must fail.
